contract.task_clause:
Which of the following should a practitioner perform as part of an engagement for agreed-upon procedures in accordance with Statements on Standards for Attestation Engagements?
Option A: Issue a report on findings based on specified procedures performed.
Option B: Assess whether the procedures meet the needs of the parties.
Option C: Express negative assurance on findings of work performed.
Option D: Report the differences between agreed-upon and audit procedures.
